doc.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Critics do environmental listening; no one can tell him how to play
summary: Most critics only follow reputation, and only another musician can help you play better.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: [Scats] No. She didn't do that, but she was singing and just, you know.
But the musicians, like, you know, [Scats] I thought I heard something there, you know. But anyway, you know what I mean.

But why did I get off on that? Oh, the critic. So, as far as the critics are concerned, for me, most critics don't know anything about what's they're listening to. Only they're doing environmental listening.
And by that I mean they listen to people that are supposed to be or so-called good and they say okay, you good, he good, okay, so then this must be good. So that's good. You know what I mean? What?
I was worried about the lawn mower. I didn't know if that was picking up.

Yeah, for a critic, they -- I don't particularly -- I don't think one way or the other. I just try to do the best I can playing. That's all. Because, you see, here's something the critic missed out on. They hear a person playing, say, this year and then they hear a person playing the next year and the person is improved, so they know that has happened? And if they did know that it happened, how come they can't say, well, he's trying to improve and he's getting honest with what he's doing and in these days honestly isn't too prevalent, so like, the guy -- I've got to give the guy credit. You know what I am trying to say?
I know exactly what you're saying.

Yeah. So, like I've -- first of all, I don't think anyone can tell me how to play what I play. I think they can tell me what to play to get better, but if I'm gonna express myself I can only do it the way I do it. Now, if you want to help me to show me the other words I can use, I'll accept that and I'll go, you know. But, you know, a lot of people that do that and try to hip you to something, but they can't tell you how to do it better. No one other than another musician, you see what I mean? Cause -- then the other people, they, Ah man, I like him better. Why? I don't know. I just like it. Well, that's a good explanation, right? I don't know. I just like it.
